none: PAS NLM-B3C1B5: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Reverse description: Female figure, possibly Providentia, standing left holding cornucopiae resting on altar with right arm pointing downwards, wand or sceptre in hand. Mintmark: Possibly R in right field. Reverse inscription: [--]AV[G]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.2mm, Weight: 1.44gms, die axis: 6
